sources.label: 🥀 Brokenn patches for apps I love
sources.author: Brokenn
patch_list: Bypasses app signature verification to allow API access.
Unlocks H.265, VP9, AV1 and 4K playback on capable devices.
Forces the Dolby Vision capability check to pass so DV streams are offered on capable displays.
Forces the HDR10 capability check to pass so HDR10 streams are offered on capable displays.
Unlocks premium UI features, removes subscription nudges, and enables downloads.
Removes pre-roll, mid-roll, live-match and home-feed ads.
